meta.title: Shim Systems | Production-Ready Data & Pipeline Sprints

section.h1: Production-Ready Data & Pipeline Sprints for High-Liability Backlogs
section.p: We take backlogged data extraction, parsing, and migration tasks off your internal team so you hit critical product go-live dates without blowing out scope or budget.
We focus entirely on getting the job done: taking messy, unstructured raw data off your hands and returning reliable, verified, and structured artifacts ready for your production environment.

tr.td: Desktop MYOB, legacy WorkflowMax, raw relational database dumps

br.br: De-duplicated, validated, and normalised database staging tables

tr.td: Xero API, Cloud SQL, Modern ERPs — zero operational downtime during transition
Contractor BoQs, trade invoices, unstructured tender PDFs

br.br: Structured JSON / REST API payloads with accurate line-item extraction

tr.td: SaaS Backend APIs & Accounting Modules — eliminates manual re-entry cost
BMS logs, utility CSVs, Scope 3 vendor records

br.br: Auditable, time-series metrics aligned to compliance schemas

tr.td: ASRS, NABERS Engines, Carbon Platforms — instant compliance audit readiness

section.p: When go-live deadlines are tight, you need an independent, senior technical partner who takes total accountability for the output without requiring hand-holding or internal supervision.

div.p: You define the required output schema; we take full responsibility for building and executing the extraction, cleansing, and staging pipelines to deliver clean data.

Direct technical execution from initial scoping to final deployment. No junior delegation, hand-offs, or management layer overhead—your project is handled by an engineer with 30 years of delivery experience.
Engagements are contracted directly through Shim Systems Pty Ltd as a standard B2B vendor contract, avoiding payroll tax, superannuation, or internal administrative friction.

section.p: Engineered with auditable, enterprise-grade tooling categories built for seamless handovers and production reliability.

div.div: Shim Systems is led by Jon Morgan, bringing 30 years of systems engineering, automated pipeline architecture, and technical consulting experience. Having co-founded and directed independent technical consultancies, Jon specialises in connecting complex operational datasets, enterprise SaaS platforms, and custom automation infrastructure.

section.p: Facing an upcoming product go-live, client migration deadline, or data pipeline bottleneck? Reach out directly via email or LinkedIn to initiate a technical discussion.
